sections.text: Equipment:Burner (for Heavy Fuel oil & Gas oil )

This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must 
be performed every six months indicated by M6 in the above title block.

The first draft initiated by eng. 
Abdel-Naeim 
Attallah Ahmed, reviewed 
& accepted by eng: Gomaa Lotfy: general director, revised by EDEPC quality control 
general director eng. Samir Abd el-Gelil, approved by eng: 
Mokhter Abd 
Elatif Mady: head sector of Ataka Power Station.

This document accepted by eng. Samir Abdel Gilil; EDEPC MPIS Coordinator and certified 
 by accountant Mahmoud Soliman, EDEPC General director of admin, 
 financial inspection and supervisor of inspection and quality control head 
 sector.

items:
A work 
 permit must be issued, the maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the 
 work area is required
Wear your safety helmet, shoes ... etc

The burner will be only dismantled after purging after closing of manual and 
 automatic fuel valves.

When closing of the manual and automatic fuel valves when the dismantling air 
 is in service and when the burner is in the back ward position.

Let the burner cool before cleaning it by immersing the head in a gas oil 
 bath.
Completely dismantle the burner head and carefully clean each of the elements.

Check the condition of inside hoses and changing 
 it if needed plates (No. 5)
Check the numbers of the spray plates and distributors (No. 1)

Measurement of holes and changing it if needed 
 (No 1.3)

Correctly reassemble the spray parts and re-assembly tighten the tip nut (No. 
 2).
After tightening the burner long purging of the (steam or air).
Check the condition of the bearing faces of yoke and if necessary lap them.

After cleaning as described above store the guns as a 
 rack and immerse the lance tip in a gas oil bath.
